name: balance
query:
SELECT 
    other.item_code,
    other.warehouse AS available_in_store,
    other.actual_qty AS available_qty
FROM 
    `tabBin` other
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabBin` ph 
        ON other.item_code = ph.item_code
        AND ph.warehouse = 'PHARMCY - SH'
WHERE 
    other.warehouse != 'PHARMCY - SH'
    AND other.actual_qty > 0
    AND IFNULL(ph.actual_qty, 0) = 0
ORDER BY 
    other.item_code;
